screen.choose: Choose the sensors in the plugin's details

app.name: Pollen forecast
app.summary: Pollen levels of the allergens you choose, today and the coming days, from the DWD in Home Assistant.
app.input_hint: The DWD Pollenflug sensor of this allergen, such as sensor.pollenflug_erle_50. Leave empty for an allergen you don't need.
app.days_hint: Today alone, or the coming days beside it.
app.show_empty_hint: Off: an allergen with no pollen on any shown day is left out.
app.sort_hint: Off: the order of the season, alder first.
app.style_hint: Circles as in the pollenprognos card, with the level in words under them or without, or bars, which take less room.
app.setting_in_bar_hint: Whether the top bar says when the pollen is strong.
app.setting_alert_level_hint: 1 very low, 2 low, 3 low to moderate, 4 moderate, 5 moderate to high, 6 high.
